cases.name: Soul Servitude
cases.text: Target player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice. When they do, you may discard a card. If you do, conjure a duplicate of the sacrificed creature into your hand. It perpetually gains "Mana of any type can be spent to cast this spell."
